OBJ_PORT_BINDING_ID.ghiChu2026_08_07: Bang chung: reference/har/portbinding.har entry 1 (GET, doi tuong THAT co 2 Instance: l2tp_internet TRUOC, internet_tr069 SAU - dung thu tu nay). Day la LOAI THIEU SOT KHAC voi dot ra soat truoc (khong phai thieu dataTag, ma thieu 1 INSTANCE trong danh sach da co) - phat hien bang cach doi chieu danh sach ten ket noi WAN da biet chac chan (internet_tr069, l2tp_internet) voi moi object co truong kieu 'ten ket noi WAN' trong factory.json. THEM 'chonTheoTruong': 'WANViewName' vi entry 3+5 cua HAR cho thay 2 request Apply LIEN TIEP tren CUNG dataTag, MOI request chi gui WANViewName (khong _InstID) de dinh danh dong can sua - neu khong co co che nay, nhanh ghi mac dinh (inst=0) se LUON ghi nham vao dong dau (l2tp_internet) ke ca khi nguoi dung sua dong internet_tr069. Xem config_store.chi_so_ghi_mac_dinh().
